task_request:
I am a PhD student studying natural language processing, and I want to deeply understand the foundational references behind the Transformer. The paper "Attention Is All You Need" (Vaswani et al., 2017) is provided as attention_is_all_you_need.pdf. Please read the last paragraph of the Background section — it cites 3 key papers. Find these 3 papers and write a 300-500 word academic summary for each, covering: the paper's core contribution, methodology overview, and its relationship to the Transformer.

Generate reference_summary.docx containing: a title, an introduction explaining the inspirations behind the Transformer, one section per paper (Heading 2), and a summary comparison table at the end. The document must end with a "References" section listing all 3 cited papers in APA format (Author, A. B. (Year). Title. Journal/Conference, Volume, Pages.). In the body text, use APA in-text citations such as (Kaiser & Sutskever, 2016) when referring to each paper.

nodes.objective: Read attention_is_all_you_need.pdf and locate the last paragraph of the Background section. Identify exactly the three cited foundational papers using the PDF's citation markers and bibliography, and record accurate bibliographic metadata.

Find reliable primary pages or papers for the three identified works and prepare a source-grounded brief for each covering core contribution, methodology, relationship to the Transformer, and accurate APA details.

Create reference_summary.docx with title, an introduction to the Transformer's inspirations, one Heading 2 section per paper containing 300-500 words and APA in-text citations, a summary comparison table, and a final References section with all three complete APA entries.

Check that exactly three source papers are covered, each section is 300-500 words, metadata and in-text citations match the references, the comparison table is present, and the document ends with References. Report checks without editing the file.
